Martha [the code in src/, one directory per capability]
Every box is a directory in src/: the name is the capability, and its test sits beside it. These 4 directories are drawn nowhere on purpose:
probe_launch_hosts: a script run by hand, npm run probe:launch, to probe a host; the command never loads it.
record_mesh_answers: a script run by hand, npm run record:mesh-answers, when a version of the mesh server is recorded; the gate reads the answers it wrote,
redo_the_generated_files_of_a_merge: a program land_batch runs over a clone when two passed heads clash only in a C4 picture or the host ceilings
(martha#381); it is run over the tree, never loaded by the core.
record_claude_code_host: a script run by hand, npm run record:claude-code-host, when the host is upgraded; the adapter reads what it writes, and never runs it.
The crew ledger is drawn in the crew's own box because a lockup now loads it. record_mesh_server_tools is drawn because the launcher imports what it
recorded; the room itself is not built, and solo admits nothing, though every launch loads the node id, the tool list and the gates its slices hold.
